shots.name: The Valley Gate
shots.intent: Arrival. Standing inside the town on the rim road, looking back upstream at the arch: the gatehouse toll window left, the porters' yard beyond it, the cargo winch head on the right shoulder, and the drop into the gorge past the rail. The road runs away from camera so the arch reads as a threshold you came through.

shots.name: The Shelf — shop street, west
shots.intent: Down the shop street eastward, with the gate stair folded in: the S-bend flight comes down off the rim into the top of frame, the Boatmen's Rest sits front-left with its sign, the chandlery and weapon shop recede east, everyday lanterns strung overhead and gorge air past the rail on the right. You see the whole arrival into the town's living street in one shot.

shots.name: The Shelf — shop street, east
shots.intent: Looking back westward up the street: the armour shop cantilevered out over the void on the left, the shop row receding toward the inn, the shelf homes closing the frame at the far end where the street turns down into the market.

shots.name: The Loop Stairs
shots.intent: The double descent: the shelf homes' little yard at the top of frame and TWO flights leaving it, turning down five metres onto the quay — one to the harbour deck, one straight into the market. Shot from out over the gorge so the whole tier stack reads at once: shelf lanterns above, stall canvas below, gorge air between them.

shots.name: The Harbour Deck
shots.intent: The heart of the town, from over the gorge at deck level: the cookhouse glow on the left, the notice board mid-deck, the open crowd space of the harbour deck, and the deep stairs' shadowed corner far left. The Shelf's lights stack up the wall behind.

shots.name: The Market
shots.intent: The stalls, close: canvas and crates filling frame, the deck opening west behind them, the long lock-head deck leaving east. Tighter than the harbour shot on purpose — this is where a player stops to buy.

shots.name: The Lockhead
shots.intent: The overlook, from high out over the basin: the harbourmistress's post at the deck's end, the long plank approach running away toward it, the maintenance ladder plunging off the edge, and Lock Five with the dam small and thunderous far below.

shots.name: Keepers' Spur
shots.intent: Intimate, from out over the basin: the keepers' cottage set against the cliff with its balcony over the drop, warm windows, and the path from the Lockhead climbing into frame from the left.

shots.name: The Crossing
shots.intent: The postcard: side-on to the span, the plank bridge sagging across frame with the basin far below, bunting snapping in the gorge wind, cottage lights waiting at the far end. TRANSIT VIGNETTE (map parcel p-crossing) — no landmarks by design.

shots.name: The Weave
shots.intent: From the cliff shoulder out over the stilt clusters — the pilot cluster's plank yard, the huts stacked on their legs, drying decks strung with nets, the Westweave tucked in under the quay's shadow, and the gorge wall receding behind. The pilot slice's proven drama angle.

shots.name: The Deep Stairs
shots.intent: The town's hidden vertical: thirteen metres of switchback flight pinned to the cliff, shot side-on so the whole zig-zag reads at once — the head's shadowed mouth at the top, the boardwalk light at the foot. No landmarks by design.

shots.name: The Boatyard
shots.intent: The ACCEPTED Boatyard v10 hero shot, reproduced exactly: low along the slipway looking upstream, hauled hulls looming over the ways, the boatwright's shed and pitch kettle to the right, Lock Four closing the view. Explicit pos/aim — a human accepted this frame, so the solver does not get to move it.

shots.name: The Waterfront — winch foot
shots.intent: The boardwalk's upstream run under the cliff: the cargo winch platform and its dangling hook, the discreet mouth of the deep stairs vanishing up into shadow behind it, fish racks starting downstream. Water on the right the whole way.

shots.name: The Fish Dock
shots.intent: Downstream along the same boardwalk: the fish dock's plank apron and drying racks filling frame, the Weave's stilt legs and its ladder coming down on the left, the shack and the moorage opening away east.

shots.name: The Keepers' Steps
shots.intent: The last descent: the cottage's own stair dropping eight metres off the spur to the basin floor, shot from out over the water so the flight reads against the cliff with the cottage balcony above it and the lock gates below. No landmarks by design.

shots.name: Lock Five
shots.intent: The water-level centrepiece, low in the gorge looking downstream: the black dam and its three wheels ahead, the lock gates, the tar-dark boat at its moorage, the tenant's shack on the near bank, and the cottage lantern-lit on the wall above — the 'house over the locks' sightline.
tasteReview: far-field character crosses the rubric's 50 px floor (51 → 49 px)

shots.name: North Landing
shots.intent: The last pier and the goodbye shot: from out on the water looking back upstream, the dam's black mass and wheels behind, the whole town stacked up the cliff above it. The night-departure stage.
